_schema.description: Machine-readable mirror of RISK-REGISTER.md. Risks scored severity × likelihood × velocity. Generated; do not hand-edit.

risks.title: Tenant data leak into search/ads (PHI/PII/PCI/KR-신용정보/PIPA-Art23)
risks.mitigation: Data Use Boundary ADR; 6-layer structural enforcement per PRIVACY-PROGRAM §2.2.4; per-class compile-time annotation; singleton platform-ads-gate source; runtime guard at auction boundary

risks.title: Cross-axis contract drift
risks.mitigation: DESIGN §10 contract surface as audit point; cross-axis PR class label; CI fitness function checks every contract against every consumer; cohesion fitness function (Foundry-improvements top-20 #13)

risks.title: Audit-chain emission gap
risks.mitigation: Mandatory emission per capability registration; CI gate governance-audit-emit; per-quarter chain-integrity check + replay drill

risks.title: Foundry agent escapes autonomy ceiling for regulated capability
risks.mitigation: Cedar policy + runtime enforcement (Foundry-improvements top-20 #1); per-capability break-glass; automated revoke; M-of-N break-glass approval per PRIVACY-PROGRAM §2.2.8

risks.title: Regional pack regulatory drift
risks.mitigation: Per-pack regulatory-change watch lane; quarterly per-pack regulatory refresh; ADR amendment per change

risks.title: Architectural flattening migration breaks main
risks.mitigation: Per-crate move PR shape (ADR-0015 plan §7); workspace-stays-green invariant; one-PR-at-a-time members modification; cargo check --all-features + cargo nextest --all-features per move

risks.title: Foundry preview slips beyond Foundation (force multiplier delayed)
risks.mitigation: Foundry preview sequenced second in optimal-path waves; Foundation is the ONLY gate; resource over-allocation if needed

risks.title: Brand rename touches public APIs incorrectly
risks.mitigation: Standalone PG-0a precursor PR per bounded context per ADR-0015 §1.5; aliases retire in Phase 7 sweep

risks.title: License drift (external dep changes Apache-2 -> AGPL/SSPL/BUSL)
risks.mitigation: License Policy ADR; governance-license CI lane; per-quarter license audit; Vendor-Partner-Ledger

risks.title: Multi-provider quota exhaustion (one provider rate-limits Foundry)
risks.mitigation: Multi-provider router with cost-aware + latency-aware fallback (top-20 #15); per-tenant per-capability budget ceilings; provider equivalence map; subscription-API failover

risks.title: Korea-locale regulatory shift mid-build (PIPA / FSC / MFDS / KCC)
risks.mitigation: Quarterly regulatory-change watch lane per ADR-0050; KR-pack maintainer engages with regulator-relations

risks.title: Cell-isolation failure (cross-tenant access)
risks.mitigation: Cell architecture ADR drafted; per-cell isolation evidence; quarterly cross-tenant access fuzz test (Issue #129)

risks.title: Subscription-mode session breakage (Claude/OpenAI/Gemini change auth flow)
risks.mitigation: Per-provider subscription contract tests (top-20 #16); subscription-API failover; PTY warm pool; idle refresh

risks.title: KCMVP HSM procurement lead-time blocks KR cloud GA
risks.mitigation: Order at month 0 of W-Cloud-Preview; secondary supplier identified

risks.title: Plugin substrate trust gate failure allows malicious plugin install
risks.mitigation: Cosign keyless signing per ADR-0039; Wasmtime sandbox per ADR-0023; plugin trust tiers per ADR-0036; sigstore + Rekor mirror

risks.title: Autonomy-ceiling implementation gap (Cedar authored but no runtime enforcement)
risks.mitigation: Top-20 #1 — runtime gate, not docs; intelligence-policy runtime check on every capability invocation

risks.title: Per-capability eval set regression on model upgrade
risks.mitigation: Per-capability eval contract; golden tasks + nightly run + regression gating

risks.title: Vertical pilot fails to prove cohesion thesis
risks.mitigation: Pre-flight check that pilot exercises >= 6 cross-axis contracts; design-partner co-author of acceptance

risks.title: M3/MVP vocab leakage from legacy docs
risks.mitigation: governance-glossary checks for retired terms; banner in PRD §3.1; ADR-0050/0185/0191 explicitly amended

risks.title: ADR backlog (71 Proposed) creates governance drift
risks.mitigation: Monthly burndown; promotion validator; per-ADR Owner+Status check; ADR-CONSOLIDATION-PLAN drafted

risks.title: Catalog projection drift (goals.json vs batch-manifest.json)
risks.mitigation: Autosync per Issue #1486; CI check

risks.title: Worktree leakage / branch-name collision
risks.mitigation: Worktree-isolation guardrails; branch-name collision detection at spawn (#58)

risks.title: Foreign data localization law shift (e.g. India / Russia / KSA mandate)
risks.mitigation: Per-pack residency declaration; cross-region replication opt-in only; legal watch

risks.title: OSS dependency vulnerability (CVE on runtime dep)
risks.mitigation: Trivy 4-layer per ADR-0039; weekly cargo-audit; auto-PR via in-house deps bump-bot

anti_patterns.name: Date-driven scope reduction
anti_patterns.counter: No date commitment in any wave gate; only state-of-correctness gate criteria

anti_patterns.name: One-time foundation bypass becomes permanent
anti_patterns.counter: Quarterly bypass-expiry review at council; auto-revert PR after expiry

anti_patterns.name: Customer X gets a one-off integration, fork the architecture
anti_patterns.counter: All customer-extension via plugin substrate or regional pack; no other path

anti_patterns.name: Privacy is a regulatory tax, minimize
anti_patterns.counter: Privacy is the moat; structural enforcement, not policy text

anti_patterns.name: Agents are unreliable, keep humans in loop forever
anti_patterns.counter: Foundry preview second after Foundation; agent-driven optimization loops baked into every axis

anti_patterns.name: Korea is hard, US first
anti_patterns.counter: Korea-pack is one regional pack; US is another; parallel onboarding per regional-pack architecture
